body:

Drive 2, Model: WD40EFRX-68WT0N0, Serial number: WD-WCC4E6NFNNV1 Several reasons may result in storage pool degradation. Please go to Storage Manager > Storage to understand the cause of degradation, or refer to this article to learn how to repair a degraded storage pool. From aduki-nas
